Description: Differences the adoption step (M1-03, owner decisions of 2026-10-18) is expected to make. Adoption also runs every fork migration step, so the Open Dental 25.4 and 26.1 schema changes (M2-01) are listed too, table by table and column by column. Everything else must be identical before and after adoption. Table, Column and Name accept * wildcards. A report can only allow preference, documentmisc, securitylog, securityloghash, displayreport and grouppermission as whole tables, the three columns whose values the 25.4 and 26.1 steps change (claimpayment.Note, insverify and insverifyhist.DateLastAssigned) as whole columns, and a new table or column without its values; AdoptionValidation adopt checks all of them row by row against the original (AdoptionRowCheck: only the changes migration-preview lists, new tables empty, new columns at their defaults), and the runbook's step 6.1 reads that check. updatehistory has no rule: adoption does not touch it. A CHECKSUM TABLE change is allowed only with another difference in its table (ReportComparer), never by a rule.

The fork migration renames the report rows Open Dental wrote under names this program does not know (step 2026101971), and adds the row of the Open Dental 25.4 UDS+ report after the FQHC Dental Sealant Measure, moving the later Public Health rows down one place (step 2027003501, M2-UDS); adding a row changes every column checksum, so only a whole-table rule can allow it (checked row by row by adopt: only the renames, the added row and the moves migration-preview lists, with the planned values).

The fork migration (step 2026102501, M2-02) splits the 25.4 blockout permission: Open Dental 25.3 PhoneExtension grants move from 272 to 274, and BlockoutAdd and BlockoutDelete go to every user group with a Blockouts grant; its UDS+ report row step (2027003501, M2-UDS) gives the user groups that may run the FQHC Dental Sealant Measure the Reports permission for the new row (checked row by row by adopt: only the moves and grants migration-preview lists).
